content: Academic alpha signals with strongest backing: Form 4 insider open-market purchases (code P) have 25+ years of replicated academic evidence (Lakonishok & Lee 2001, Jeng et al. 2003) showing 5-10% annual alpha in top quintile, strongest in first 30 days. Congressional STOCK Act buys have pre-2012 evidence of 55-85 bps/month alpha (Ziobrowski 2004/2011), post-STOCK Act evidence still shows 3-8% annual alpha for mimicking (Karadas 2018), concentrated in committee members trading in their sector. 12-1 momentum is one of the most replicated factors (Jegadeesh & Titman 1993, Carhart 1997) with 4-6% annual premium. Cluster buys (multiple insiders/legislators) amplify all signals.
